title: Parity product over a color class
statement: Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers, let $j_0\in[m]$, let $T\subseteq[n]$, and let $\pi\colon[n]\to[m]$. If $F_{j_0}(\pi)=\{i\in[n]:\pi(i)=j_0\}$, then $$(-1)^{|T\cap F_{j_0}(\pi)|}=\prod_{i\in[n]} b_i,$$ where $b_i=-1$ if $i\in T$ and $\pi(i)=j_0$, and $b_i=1$ otherwise.
replaced: Let $n,m\ge0$, $j_0\in[m]$, $T\subseteq[n]$, and $\pi\colon[n]\to[m]$, and put $F_{j_0}(\pi)=\{i:\pi(i)=j_0\}$. Then $(-1)^{|T\cap F_{j_0}(\pi)|}=\prod_{i=1}^n b_i$, where $b_i=-1$ if $i\in T$ and $\pi(i)=j_0$, and $b_i=1$ otherwise.
